description: This file defines constants, enums, data classes, and functions related to launching an assistant or handling associated intents within an Android application. It processes intents for opening the assistant and extracting relevant data such as prompts.

classes.name: HomeDestination
classes.description: An enum representing various destinations within the home app interface, such as Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchRequest
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the source, optional prompt, and auto-send flag for launching the assistant.

methods.name: parseAssistantLaunchIntent
methods.description: Parses an Android Intent to produce an AssistantLaunchRequest object, extracting the action, prompt, and autoSend flag based on the intent's data.
